title: [YouPass Collect] - Time Spent by Students on Different Types of Websites

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The pie charts compare the proportions of time spent by male and female students on five different categories of websites.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, there were notable differences between the two groups, with sport-related websites being the most visited by male students, whereas their female counterparts devoted the largest share of their time to study websites. Meanwhile, the proportion of time spent on other types of websites was identical for both genders.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding the categories with the most significant gender differences, sport websites attracted the highest percentage of male students' time, at 35%, which was more than three times the figure for females, at only 10%. Conversely, study websites accounted for 45% of female students' time, the single largest figure across all categories for either gender, compared to a considerably lower proportion of 30% for males. Additionally, female students spent four times as much time on shopping websites as their male peers, at 20% and 5%, respectively, representing the widest gap in relative terms.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: As for the remaining categories, male students allocated a fifth of their time to news websites, at 20%, which was 5 percentage points higher than the 15% recorded for female students, a relatively narrow gap compared to the categories mentioned above. Finally, both groups devoted an equal and relatively modest share of 10% of their time to other, unspecified website types, making it the only category where no difference between genders was observed.
